paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.20% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+3.67%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-1.79%). Brent crude changed +2.34% to 96.83. Gold changed +1.53% to 4,135.2002. Bitcoin changed -0.84% to 79,728.0938. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.894%, a relative move of -1.17%. Among the firms tracked, Newmont (+9.90%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+9.01%) moved the most.
